vo.en: You physically cannot move this finger.

visual.description: An extreme macro shot of a man's hand with fingers twitching slightly against a dark background.

vo.en: Press your palms together, interlock your fingers, and tuck your middle fingers down so they touch.

visual.description: Clear demonstration of a man's hands interlocking and folding the middle fingers inward.

vo.en: Now, try to lift just your ring finger while keeping all other fingers glued shut.

visual.description: A man's hand struggling intensely to lift the ring finger while the rest are clamped.

vo.en: It’s completely frozen, right? But here is the creepy part.

visual.description: Fast-paced digital glitch effect with blue and yellow light streaks over an abstract brain.

vo.en: Your ring finger lacks its own independent extensor muscle. It is tethered to the middle finger by a shared tendon.

visual.description: Detailed 3D anatomical model showing the tendons and muscles of a human hand in motion.

vo.en: While other fingers move freely, this one is a prisoner of your own biology.

visual.description: Abstract shot of heavy iron chains rattling or a red warning light flashing in a dark room.

vo.en: Subscribe for tomorrow's body glitch and comment TRAPPED if you failed... which is exactly why

visual.description: A man pointing directly into the lens with a confident expression and a quick nod.
